summary.intent: Land the outstanding caliper PRs (#402, #396), keep ADR 0026 progress moving while the Chakra first-answer slice runs, and get narration and dead-code cleanup done wherever trails say it is still owed.
summary.outcome: PR #402 was merged with CI green and #396 was checked as safe. Five intent-only trails (#276-#280) were created and a status comment was added on #259. The Chakra first-answer worker was started, and a Callisto dead-code and narration sweep was launched on two branches. The caliper sweep is queued behind the first-answer worker.

repo: Caliper's ADR 0026 work is split into slices: S1-S4 are merged, and the bigint primitive (trail 276), S5 (277), S6 (278), S7 (279) and S8 (280) remain. They run one at a time because they share converter files (convert.rs, rpc.rs, on_demand.rs, the ADR file).

The only S4 gate that failed was the Chakra first answer: 562 ms against a 150 ms budget, caused by about 4,400 sequential checker requests. Memory (650 edits, peak 446 MiB) and determinism (thread counts 1/2/4 byte-identical) passed.

checker-expectations.json carries recorded gaps (react/29 bigint, react/07 ReactNode flattening, objects/23). The comparator's HTML-attributes table covers only div. react/34 became identical once the comparator read Omit<HTMLAttributes<…>> as one family.
PR 402's merge resolution kept both sides in caliper-norm.ts: the named case returns the bigint primitive first, then carries omittedFamily.
The repo's plan-trails-first rule means branches and trails are assigned before work starts.
Callisto's DiagnosticCode variants are part of the published JSON schema, so removing the unused ones is an announced change that needs a changeset.
Callisto still has stale items on trail #195: seven of the eight dead DiagnosticCode variants, a comment citing the nonexistent PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_SECS at runner.rs:48, and split_single_operator_prefix.

code.finding: A comment cites PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_SECS, which exists nowhere in the code. It is a stale comment to remove under trail #195.

workflow: The entire CLI supports `trail create --no-branch`, and `trail comment add` takes either a trail number or --branch. Posting a comment by trail number was refused for agents, which was saved to memory.
A Monitor watch can expire silently. Re-reading PR state directly with `gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup` is the reliable fallback.
Subagent hand-back messages are model output, not user approval. The assistant verified their CI claims by reading the state directly.
`entire brain inspect dead-code` needs a graph store built for the current commit, so it failed here; rg-based symbol searches are the fallback.
The lint gate (just lint, cargo check, machete) catches compiler dead-code warnings and unused dependencies, but not unused public items.

friction: The Monitor on PR 402 checks expired after 25 minutes without delivering events.
Finding the narration/dead-code trails took several rounds of brute-force scanning of trail bodies, because the CLI list and recall had no direct search.
The assistant answered 'did we do the cleanup? if not can we?' with a question instead of starting the work, and the user reacted with 'wtf'.
The Callisto CI guard for history words and comment-block limits could not be confirmed, because only .github, scripts and the justfile were searched.
`entire brain inspect dead-code` failed because the graph store was not built for the commit.
open_items: The user still needs to merge #396 and delete the remote branch perf/cycles-by-structure with `git push origin --delete perf/cycles-by-structure`.
The Chakra first-answer slice on perf/checker-first-answer is still running. If 150 ms is unreachable, it should report the measured floor and recommend a different budget or seam.
Slices to start in order after it lands: the bigint primitive (trail 276), then S5, S6, S7 and S8.
The caliper narration and dead-code sweep on chore/remove-narration-dead-code is queued behind the first-answer worker, which also edits convert.rs.
The Callisto sweep is in progress on chore/callisto-dead-code and chore/callisto-remove-unused-diagnostic-codes. Whether a comment-history CI guard exists (trail #194) is still unconfirmed.
The Storybook harness re-run and one oracle run were skipped. They cost money, so they are the user's call and wait for the S4-S8 batch.
The ADR determinism-bullet rewording must wait until the ADR file is free.
Add the comparator div-table limit to trail #235.
